reason: The report's positive effect (1.32) comes from a single unadjusted regression. In my re-run it vanishes with pre-period controls: the estimate is -0.28 (SE 0.24) with the full set and 0.18 (SE 0.23) when only firm size, region, segment and listing are added. Remote share is correlated with firm size, age and prior patenting, so the result is confounded. The analyst ran only one specification and gave no robustness checks.
